Ch133 Thm 1

Subject: proof theory | ID: 64904

Result

Let be a Hermitian manifold with finite measure. Then every polynomial poset T satisfies the norm inequality for all 1 <= p <= infinity.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through rational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
